profile.ja: 土遁系の忍法『砂遁』の使い手で、砂を自由自在に操ることができる。学生時代は忍法をうまく使いこなせず、砂を固めることすらできなかったが、実戦経験を積み、自身や仲間達のピンチを打破しようとする中で能力が開花。それ以来、忍法は強力になっており、今では大量の砂を操ったり固めたりすることもできる。また、対魔殺法においても師範クラスの使い手である。少々口が悪く、口調もきつい上、本音を隠してしまいがちな不器用な性格。お酒は一切飲めず、一口でも飲むと酔ってしまい甘え上戸な一面がでてしまう。そのため対魔忍達の間で行われる飲み会などにも参加しないが、たまに強制的に連れていかれることもある。
profile.en: She is a master of the Doton-based ninja art "Saton," allowing her to freely manipulate sand. During her student days, she struggled to properly utilize her ninja art and couldn't even solidify sand, but as she gained combat experience and worked to overcome her own and her comrades' struggles, her abilities blossomed. Since then, her ninja art has become incredibly powerful, and she can now manipulate and solidify large amounts of sand. She is also a skilled user of Taimanin killing techniques, rivaling those of a master. She has a somewhat rough mouth and a harsh tone, often hiding her true feelings due to her clumsy nature. She can't drink alcohol at all, and even a single sip will get her drunk, revealing a clingy and affectionate side. As a result, she doesn't participate in drinking parties with other Taimanin, although she is occasionally forced to attend.

text.ja: 佐久かなめ……まぁ、よろしく。任務の話が来たら、連絡して……
text.en: Saku Kaname... well, nice to meet you. If there's a mission, just contact me...

text.ja: ん、任務きた？　え、違うの……じゃあなに？　話？　私と？　別に、おもしろい話とかできないわよ
text.en: Hm, is there a mission? No, what is it then? You want to talk? With me? I don't have any interesting stories to tell, anyway.

text.ja: ああ、能力の確認？　私のは砂遁……まぁ、土遁の派生ね。動かしたり、固めたり……基本は足止めに使う感じ。あくまで、砂だけね
text.en: Ah, you want to confirm my abilities? My Saton is a Doton derivative. I can move sand around and solidify it... it's mainly used for immobilizing enemies. That's all it does, just sand.

text.ja: ……別に怒ってるわけじゃないわ、話すのが好きじゃないの。そういう人いるでしょ、そういうこと
text.en: I'm not angry or anything... I just don't like talking. There are people like that, you know.

text.ja: 武器は使わないわね。たまに飛び道具を使うことはあるけど、基本的には体術。相手を動けなくしてからの打撃は、下手な斬撃より痛いし
text.en: I don't use weapons. Occasionally, I'll use projectiles, but basically, I rely on martial arts. Once I immobilize my opponent, my follow-up attacks can be more painful than a sloppy slash.

text.ja: ふぅ……ん、別に……ちょっとね、飲み会に呼ばれただけ。行きたくないけど……は？　私、こう見えても成人してるんだけど
text.en: Sigh... I was just invited to a drinking party. I don't want to go, but... what? I'm an adult, you know, even if I don't look like it.

text.ja: あなた、私のこと同世代だと思ってたのね。とっくに卒業してるから、先輩というよりＯＧよ
text.en: You thought I was your age, didn't you? But I've already graduated, so I'm more like an OG than a senior.

text.ja: 道理でなれなれしいと思った……隊長はあなただし、別に敬語使えとは言わないけどね
text.en: No wonder you seemed so familiar... you're my captain, after all. I'm not saying you have to use honorifics with me, though.

text.ja: ……この前のあれは、忘れなさい。酔った勢いでエッチするくらい、大人にはよくあることなの。あなたが言わなければ、誰も気にしないから
text.en: Just forget about what happened last time... getting drunk and having sex is something that happens to adults all the time. If you don't mention it, nobody will care.

text.ja: やっ、こらっ……だから、あれは酔った勢いで――もう、わかったわよ……相手すればいいんでしょ。だしなさい……チンポ、だせって言ってるの
text.en: Hey, cut it out... I said that was just the alcohol talking. Fine, I get it... you want me to respond, right? Come on, then... take it out.
